items.title: In Race With US, China Struggles to Recruit Foreign AI Researchers (6 minute read)
items.snippet: China has made recruiting the world's best scientists a national priority. It introduced a visa for scientists and is offering lucrative research grants. Foreigners are not coming despite those efforts. The number of Chinese scientists working in the US has risen rather than declined.

items.title: A $12B DeepSeek Raise Is Reportedly Close, With Tencent And CATL Among Backers (3 minute read)
items.snippet: DeepSeek is nearing a $12 billion raise, surpassing its initial 50 billion yuan target, with Tencent and CATL as major contributors. The funding boost follows the release of DeepSeek's latest AI model, with expectations it might reach 100 billion yuan. The company is also preparing for a potential Shanghai STAR Market IPO, employing CITIC Securities for assistance.

items.title: Claude now works with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides (4 minute read)
items.snippet: Claude now integrates with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides for all paid plans, allowing direct editing within files.

items.title: US-China AI Gap Hits 3%, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Now Leads on Agentic Coding Benchmarks (12 minute read)
items.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, a Chinese AI model, now leads in agentic coding benchmarks, surpassing US competitors.

items.title: Hark debuts an AI agent a year before its first devices (2 minute read)
items.snippet: Hark has released an AI agent that buys groceries, books cars, and pays bills.

items.title: AICR v1.0: Open, stable, and verifiable GPU cluster configuration (6 minute read)
items.snippet: NVIDIA's AI Cluster Runtime (AICR) v1.0 offers version-locked, validated recipes for stable GPU-accelerated Kubernetes cluster configurations.

items.title: Anthropic Expands Verified Access to Cyber Capabilities (4 minute read)
items.snippet: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program into three access tiers for qualifying security professionals, providing its most capable models with reduced cyber blocking.

items.title: A Change in AI Strategy
items.snippet: AI models have reached commodity status as prices fall 41% while token usage surges 50%. To win relative share, labs should partner & resell models, control the user interface where distribution becomes the moat, & capture routing data to reduce the cost of training future models.
